title: In Korea, You See a Specialist Today

slides.headline: In Korea, you see a **specialist today.**
slides.note: No appointment, no referral, a few thousand won.

slides.headline: Walk in, **no booking**
slides.body: Neighborhood clinics (동네 병원) see patients in order of arrival. Most visits need no appointment.

slides.headline: No **gatekeeper**
slides.body: No family doctor has to refer you. Sore ear? Go straight to an ear, nose and throat clinic (이비인후과).

slides.headline: A **building** of doctors
slides.body: Medical buildings stack clinics floor by floor: skin, eyes, teeth, kids. The pharmacy is usually on the ground floor.

slides.headline: Doctor writes, **pharmacist fills**
slides.body: Since 2000, clinics prescribe and pharmacies dispense (의약분업). You carry the slip downstairs.

slides.headline: You pay **about 30%**
slides.body: National Health Insurance covers almost everyone. At a clinic, the patient pays roughly 30% of the bill.

slides.headline: Bring **your ID**
slides.body: Since May 2024 clinics check ID at the desk. A mobile ID or the insurance app also works.

slides.headline: Doctor visits **per person, per year**
slides.body: The most in the OECD, where the average is 6.5 (2023).

slides.headline: A cold is **a clinic visit.**
slides.body: When a doctor is a short walk and a short wait away, people go.

slides.headline: Korea, explained **by a Korean.**
slides.body: Follow for the context behind the things Korea does.
slides.graphic: Clinic waiting area, softly blurred behind the text.

caption:
In Korea, you can walk into a specialist's clinic today without an appointment or a referral.

The visit usually costs a few thousand won, and the pharmacy is often downstairs.

How long does it take to see a doctor where you live?
reply: One more: for people 65 and older, a clinic visit that costs ₩15,000 or less in total is a flat ₩1,500 at the desk. Many clinics also open on Saturday mornings. Do you need a referral to see a specialist where you live?
fact_check: 2장: 의원 외래 접수순 진료, 예약 불필요가 일반적 — 일반 관행.
3장: 의원급은 진료의뢰서 없이 바로 진료. 의뢰서는 상급종합병원 보험급여에만 필요 — 국민건강보험법 시행규칙 요양급여 절차(1단계·2단계).
6장: 의원 외래 본인부담률 30% — 국민건강보험법 시행령 별표2. 건강보험+의료급여로 사실상 전 국민.
7장: 요양기관 본인확인 의무화 2024-05-20, 모바일 건강보험증·모바일 신분증 인정 — 보건복지부·건보공단.
8장: 1인당 연간 의사 대면진료 약 18회(2023), OECD 평균 6.5회, OECD 1위 — OECD Health at a Glance 2025 'Consultations with doctors'.
댓글: 65세 이상 의원 외래 총진료비 15,000원 이하 1,500원 정액 — 국민건강보험법 시행령 별표2. 토요일 오전 진료는 일반 관행.
